label: Restrict panel access by IP/CIDR
desc: Only the listed IPv4/IPv6 addresses and networks can access the panel API. Enter one address or CIDR per line.
empty_hint: An empty list disables the restriction.
recovery_hint: If locked out, run as root on the server:
temporary_desc: Allow one IP or network for a limited time without changing the permanent list.
